scripts.dev: bash scripts/cleanup-dev-ports.sh 3000 3001 3002 3100 && concurrently -k -n portal,monkeytype,shooter,recall "pnpm dev:portal" "pnpm dev:monkeytype:app" "pnpm dev:shooter:app" "pnpm dev:recall:app"

scripts.dev:recall: bash scripts/cleanup-dev-ports.sh 3002 3100 && concurrently -k -n portal,recall "pnpm dev:portal" "pnpm dev:recall:app"
